pka-ladder.alt: A pH axis for an acid with pKa 4.7: below pH 4.7 the protonated form HA predominates, above it the deprotonated form A⁻ predominates, and at pH 4.7 they are equal. The ratio [A⁻]:[HA] is 1:10 one unit below pKa and 10:1 one unit above. An indicator with pKa 9.3 changes color from about pH 8.3 to 10.3.
